root_cause: src/core/algorithms/scene3d.js:5084-5215 structural edge pass draws the projected MESH silhouette (a chord polygon inscribed in the true one); src/core/scene3d/surface-fill.js's fill already reaches the analytic terminator. The gap between them is the drawn-border deficit.
fix: New silhouetteProjectLocal (scene3d.js, near sliceAnalyticProjectLocal, ~line 665-716) solves F(p)=0 and G(p)=grad F . v=0 by Newton with a numerical grad G, projecting silhouette/boundary edge vertices AND 4x-subdivided interior points onto the analytic silhouette/rim. Gated to convex charted primitives (torus excluded). View direction v is derived per REFINED POINT (not once per record) from the pass's own projector, exact under orthographic and required for correctness under perspective (plan §3.7).
